answer: Precondition: graded work pays into escrow, never straight to the worker. Any attempt to link two identities resets every escrow balance to zero, and rewards vest only against future work, so nobody withdraws what he has not earned. A field of yarrow looks like many plants but shares one root, and the ledger treats linked accounts the same way. A farmer may wander from one canyon of accounts to the next; the escrow follows the address and his yield stays at zero.
